PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1948/36 – THURSDAY, JANUARY 07, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/157.

I, hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of Land to be Acquired: Public purpose means the land Acquisition for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below shown in Sheet No. 29 of supplement 29 in Village Plan 531 approved by Surveyor General dated on 07.06.2013, situated at Koongahawela village in Millagahamulatenna Grama Niladhari Division, Gangala pallesiya Pattuwa of Naula Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central province.
